🎥🎬: DANG! (2025)

The story follows a group of siblings whose lives are thrown into chaos when an unexpected situation forces them to confront problems within their family. What starts as an ordinary part of their lives quickly becomes complicated as old tensions, secrets, and disagreements begin coming to the surface.

As the siblings try to navigate their changing circumstances, they are forced to rely on one another despite their differences. Their relationships are tested by misunderstandings, family drama, and the consequences of choices they make along the way.

Through the chaos, the siblings gradually discover that family can be complicated, but the bond between them is difficult to break. The series mixes humor, drama, and heartfelt moments as they try to figure out their lives together.
